dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'm not all that hungry right now, I'm afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: *sigh* True, true. If you eat while you're very full, even the most delicious food would seem merely ordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Well then, come back when you're feeling hungry and want to try some Melusine cuisine. Don't forget, now!
